briefdescription.para: Get the signs of the correction on the derivatives. The sign of the computed interface derivative can be wrong in the case the axes do not agree.
Class to compute the interface derivatives along a given direction on all the interfaces with an approximation formula.

detaileddescription.para: This operator is implemented for conforming equivalent global meshes.

When we call the operator .solve_deriv() or .solve_cross_deriv(), the operator loops over the interface to compute the vector C_trunc to determine all the interface derivatives and update the DerivField given in input.
The vector C_trunc is given by the coefficients (see README), $ \{\sum_{k = - N_{reduc}}^{N_{reduc}} \omega_{k, N_{reduc}, N_{reduc}}^{i_I} f_{i_I+k} \}_I $

with
$ N_{reduc} $ the number of chosen cells for the approximation,
$ i_I $ the index of the grid at the Ith interface,
$ f_{i_I+k} $ the function values if we compute the first derivatives, or the first derivatives if we compute the cross-derivatives.

parameterdescription.para: A MultipatchConnectivity class describing all the patch connections.
List of patches containing all the involved patches in the given direction.
A InterfaceDerivCoeffsCollection that stores the InterfaceDerivCoeffs needed to compute the interface derivatives.
